title: British Sprint & Middle Distance Champs 2017
text: Congratulations to all those who took part in the British Sprint & Middle Distance Championships last weekend. SuffOC's Tim Harrison achieved 11th place in the Sprint Men's Open 'A' final in Campbell Park, Milton Keynes on the Saturday & went on to win the Bronze medal in his age class in the Middle Distance event in Wendover Woods on the Sunday. Two other EAJS members were also awarded Bronze medals in the Middle Distance, Daisy Partridge & Tom Martin, both from SOS. Full results can be found here.
